author: Rob Braxman Tech
description:
More and more computer user are flocking to Linux. But what's surprising is that a large number migrated to Zorin. Apparently it got 2 Million downloads in 3 months with the new Zorin 18 version. 

Why are Ex-Windows users migrating to this choice of distro? Does it deserve this attention? Let's do a deep analysis of what makes Zorin tick and let's find out if I will change my recommendations and point new Linux users from Windows to this distro.
